title: Set the standard fork air pressure
completeness: Complete assembled-bike air-pressure baseline. Damping adjustments, internal service and spring-conversion forks are excluded.
entry_state: Assembled standard US FC450, F2475Y2, with original air fork.
Engine stopped; consistent conditions for pressure comparisons.
exit_state: Pressure set, pump removed and cap fitted; bike lowered.
Remove parking stand before the slow handling check.

source.review_note: Exact US variant and pressure row checked; pages53,54,60,61 visually reviewed. No damping direction inferred from contradictory pages55-57. Independent root review accepted air-only scope after text53/54/60/61 and visual54 check; no physical execution claimed.

applicability.included: Stock US2025 FC450 F2475Y2 air fork

required_tools.name: Fork air pump with readable gauge and supplied operating instructions
Suitable lift stand and plug-in parking stand

preflight: Wait at least five minutes after stopping the engine.
Keep comparisons under the same conditions. This restores the standard pressure, not a personalized setting.
critical_stop_conditions: Unstable support, damaged valve or unreadable pressure gauge.
Pressure cannot be set or retained.
Handling remains abnormal after the slow check.

steps.title: Match the checking conditions
steps.instruction: Wait at least five minutes after engine-off. Use consistent conditions for comparison.

steps.title: Unload the fork
steps.instruction: On firm level ground, remove the plug-in stand. Lift beneath the engine frame until both wheels clear; secure against tipping. Nobody sits on the raised bike.

steps.title: Connect the fork pump
steps.instruction: Remove the left fork valve cap. Fully assemble the specified pump and connect following its supplied instructions. Connection air loss fills the hose.

steps.title: Set the US baseline
steps.instruction: Set 10.5 bar (152.3 psi). Keep within 7-12 bar; any later tuning changes use 0.2-bar steps. Record the pressure.

steps.title: Disconnect and close
steps.instruction: Disconnect the pump; escaping hose pressure is expected. Refit the protection cap by hand only.

steps.title: Lower and park
steps.instruction: Lower the bike and remove the lift. If parking, insert the plug-in stand into the left wheel spindle.

steps.title: Check the response
steps.instruction: Remove the plug-in stand before riding. Begin slowly to assess the changed handling; record the result.
